title: Work Map Autofix v2 governance contract regression

phases.objective: Align the repository governance graph, recovery bridge, automation-overlap policy, runbook, and executable regressions with the existing Work Map Autofix v2 exact-dispatch writer without changing either workflow or granting new authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The current E2E Work Map recovery bridge, Spec Kit Work Map Autofix v2 workflow, and their central pipeline and automation-overlap contracts
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives deterministic passing evidence only when one-time pull-request authorization remains in the non-writer recovery bridge, the sole writer remains workflow_dispatch-only and exact-head bound, and branch exclusions, shared concurrency, idempotent generation, bounded diagnostics, and no-force-push controls agree across policy, documentation, and tests.
steps: Load the current E2E Work Map recovery bridge without modifying or executing it.
Load the current Work Map Autofix v2 workflow without modifying or executing it.
Validate the central recovery-bridge and writer pipeline declarations against strings, triggers, permissions, and non-writer boundaries present in the live workflows.
Validate the automation-overlap resource group uses the exact current v2 concurrency key.
Validate the Supervisor runbook documents the separation between one-time bridge authorization and the workflow-dispatch exact-head writer.
Run the Pipeline Connectivity, Automation Overlap, and Supervisor Runtime Assurance regressions against the same repository tree.
assertions: Work Map Autofix remains the sole remote writer for docs/work-maps.
The one-time work-map-autofix authorization marker is consumed only by the E2E recovery bridge, which dispatches the writer without generating, committing, or pushing Work Maps.
The recovery bridge is bound to an immutable same-repository pull-request snapshot and delegates the exact branch head to the writer.
The writer has no pull_request trigger or authorization marker and is started only by workflow_dispatch with an existing same-repository pull-request branch and exact expected_head_sha.
main and Production are rejected as targets, and local plus remote head identity is verified before generation and push.
The policy-declared Work Map resource group exactly matches the workflow v2 concurrency key and keeps cancel-in-progress disabled.
Generation remains idempotent and rejects changes outside docs/work-maps.
The writer uses no force push and publishes bounded v2 diagnostic evidence.
This change modifies governance, documentation, and regressions only; it does not change or execute either workflow and does not mutate Work Maps.

phases.objective: Observe the next explicitly authorized Work Map Autofix v2 dispatch and confirm exact-head readback and diagnostic evidence under its existing governance boundary.
